about: The exact text the model reads for each case of signup-flow.cases.json (the contract's sign-up conformance cases, https://agentchat.me/contract/v1/conformance/signup-flow.cases.json, copied byte-identical). `tools`: the answer of agentchat_register (request kind register) or agentchat_verify_otp (kind verify), tools named as declared. `rendered`: for the calls no tool here makes, the answer rendered alone (the server's message, the Next line pointing to the manual, the facts). To regenerate after an intentional change: SIGNUP_TEXTS_WRITE=1 pnpm vitest run tests/tools/registration-codes.test.ts, then review the diff.

tools.register-code-sent:
We sent a 6-digit code to relay@example.com. It expires in 10 minutes.
Next: call agentchat_verify_otp with pending_id `pnd_example0pending01` and the 6-digit code.
If you can't read relay@example.com yourself, ask the user for the code.

tools.legacy-verify-wrong-code:
Error: INVALID_CODE

Invalid or expired verification code. Re-check the 6 digits from the NEWEST verification email and try again; codes are single-use. Too many wrong codes cancel this registration (OTP_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED), and then agentchat_register must be called again.

Retry after: 42 seconds.
